description: This file contains Drupal hook implementations for the Workspaces module, including help text, pre-installation setup, menu update handling, and scheduled cleanup tasks related to workspaces.

classes.name: WorkspacesHooks
classes.description: Contains hook implementations for the Drupal Workspaces module, handling help display, module preinstall configuration, menu updates, and cron cleanup tasks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies for workspace management, tracking, entity info, and cache invalidation.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Provides help information for the Workspaces module when the help route is accessed.

methods.name: modulePreinstall
methods.description: Performs setup tasks before the module is installed, such as updating entity types supported by workspaces.

methods.name: menuLinkContentUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to menu link content entities, invalidating cache if revisions differ.

methods.name: cron
methods.description: Scheduled task that cleans up deleted workspaces and associated revisions.
